description: Orchestrator self-refactoring to fix performance bottlenecks and architectural anti-patterns

tasks.prompt: Create comprehensive backup of the orchestrator codebase. Create tar.gz archive of src/, docs/, and test/ directories. Store in backups/pre_refactor_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).tar.gz. Verify backup integrity.
Create new git branch 'refactor/performance-improvements' and commit current state with message 'feat: start orchestrator self-improvement refactor'. Ensure clean working tree.

Run performance benchmarks on current orchestrator. Measure: task throughput, memory usage per agent, token pool contention metrics, file I/O latency. Create baseline_metrics.json with all measurements.

Refactor TokenPool class to eliminate contention. Implement: 1) Lock-free token distribution using asyncio.Queue, 2) Token reservation system with timeout, 3) Batch token allocation for multi-agent tasks. Maintain backward compatibility.
Replace synchronous file I/O with async operations using aiofiles. Focus on: checkpoint saves, log writes, result storage. Create FileIOManager class to centralize async file operations.

Implement connection pooling for AI provider APIs. Create ProviderConnectionPool class with: keep-alive connections, automatic retry with exponential backoff, connection health monitoring. Support Claude and OpenAI providers.
Create comprehensive test suite for concurrency improvements. Test: token pool under load (100 concurrent requests), async file I/O performance, connection pool failover. All tests must pass.
Commit concurrency improvements with message 'perf: eliminate concurrency bottlenecks in token pool and file I/O'. Include performance metrics showing improvements in commit message.

Optimize memory usage: 1) Implement task result streaming instead of loading all in memory, 2) Add memory-mapped file support for large outputs, 3) Implement garbage collection hints after task completion. Target: reduce memory per agent by 50%.
Add multiprocessing support for CPU-intensive operations. Create ProcessPoolExecutor wrapper for: JSON parsing, file compression, metrics calculation. Maintain async interface.
Implement ResourceMonitor class to track and limit resource usage. Features: memory limits per task, CPU throttling, automatic task suspension when limits exceeded. Integrate with monitoring module.
Test resource optimizations: Run 15 parallel agents and verify memory stays under 400MB total, CPU usage scales across cores, no memory leaks after 100 task executions.
Commit resource optimizations with message 'perf: reduce memory usage by 50% and add multiprocessing support'.
Refactor GenericOrchestrator god object. Extract responsibilities into: TaskScheduler, WorkflowEngine, MetricsCollector, StateManager. Each class under 500 lines. Maintain public API compatibility.

Replace singleton pattern with dependency injection. Create OrchestratorFactory with configurable providers. Implement interfaces for TokenProvider, FileHandler, MessageBus. Enable testing with mock implementations.

Add behavior to data classes following DDD principles. Enhance AgentTask with: validate(), execute(), retry() methods. Create TaskResult value object with success/failure factory methods. Implement Task aggregate root.

Create integration test suite for refactored architecture. Test: all workflows still execute correctly, backwards compatibility maintained, new components integrate properly. Must achieve 90% code coverage.
Commit architectural improvements with message 'refactor: eliminate god object and singleton anti-patterns using SOLID principles'.

Run comprehensive benchmarks comparing refactored vs baseline. Generate comparison report showing: throughput improvement %, memory reduction %, CPU utilization improvement. Must show 2x improvement in at least 2 metrics.

Update all documentation to reflect new architecture. Update: ARCHITECTURE.md with new component design, API_REFERENCE.md with new classes, DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md with new patterns. Include migration guide for existing users.
Perform security audit on refactored code. Check: no new vulnerabilities introduced, token handling remains secure, file permissions properly set, no sensitive data logged.
Final review of all changes. Verify: all tests pass, documentation complete, performance targets met, backwards compatibility maintained. Create final approval report.
Create pull request from refactor/performance-improvements to main branch. Include: performance metrics, test results, breaking changes (if any). Merge after all checks pass.
